sources.title: Enervating Suffusion
markers: | summary = '''Enervating Suffusion''' is a passive feature that adds force damage to unarmed attacks.

sources.title: High Spellcasting (+1)
markers: | summary = '''High Spellcasting''' is a passive feature that makes the wearers spells more potent and difficult to defend against.

sources.title: Command
markers: | summary = It allows spellcasters to order their target to flee, move closer, freeze, drop to the ground, or drop their weapon.

summary: Unarmed attacks deal +1d4 Force, your spell save DC rises by 1, and you can cast level 3 Command once per Long Rest.

fields.Command: Action once per Long Rest, cast at level 3 without your spell slots. Select up to three creatures within 60 ft and give the Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel or Halt command. Target resists with a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. Lasts 1 turn and requires no Concentration. Undead are unaffected, and targets do not obey a directly harmful command.
fields.Base value: 300 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
